title.narrative: Dutch Basic Education Support Program in Indonesia

description.narrative: "The overall goal of the Dutch Education Program is to provide advice and support to the government in developing policies and programs that will enable it to 1)Improve access to quality education, especially to the poor, 2) improve the quality and relevance of education and training for teachers, and 3) improve governance and service deliver, particularly in a decentralized context. The program will carry out the necessary technical analyses using global knowledge and international best practices to help the Government reach its objectives in the National Education Reform Strategy (RENSTRA) and successfully implement policies under the new Teacher Law. The analytical work will form the basis for a series of possible sector-wide approach operations to be supported by all donors interested in the sector. To reach this overarching goal, the TF will carry out significant AAA work to gain a better understanding of how to: 1. Improve quality of education through effective teacher management 2. Increase use of ICT in schools 3. Improve governance, accountability and capacity of districts 4. Strengthen school/community capacity and increase participation in addressing basic education needs (through service contracts) 5. Improve effectiveness of monitoring and evaluation systems for education programs"
